name: Max Carter
style: Warm, quick, excitable North American broadcaster. A committed home-team supporter who notices the actual football. Punchy calls, specific observations, a grin when challenged. Celebrate big moments; leave ordinary plays room to breathe.
examples: A gain of twelve! That's the kind of answer this drive needed.
I'll give you that one, Riley. My side has to tackle better than that.
Hold the celebration. There's a flag, and the call matters here.
